questions.question: How did the Lord react after hearing Brahma's prayer?

options.text: He heartily laughed and accepted it with a glance laden with love

questions.explanation: "...the Lord heartily laughed and accepted his prayer with a glance laden with love." (SB 3.19.1)

questions.question: From which part of Brahma had the Lord (as boar) appeared?
questions.explanation: "The Lord, who had appeared from the nostril of Brahma, sprang and aimed His mace at the chin of His enemy..." (SB 3.19.2)

questions.question: What happened to the Lord's mace when struck by the demon's mace?

options.text: It slipped from His hand and fell down whirling

questions.explanation: "Struck by the demon's mace, however, the Lord's mace slipped from His hand and looked splendid as it fell down whirling." (SB 3.19.3)

questions.question: Why did the demon not strike the Lord while He was unarmed?

options.text: He respected the law of single combat

questions.explanation: "...he respected the law of single combat, thereby kindling the fury of the Supreme Lord." (SB 3.19.4)

questions.question: Which weapon did the Lord invoke after His mace fell, acknowledging the demon's love of righteousness?
questions.explanation: "...the Personality of Godhead acknowledged the demon's love of righteousness and therefore invoked His Sudarsana discus." (SB 3.19.5)

questions.question: With what did the Lord, in His boar form, knock down the demon's mace as it came at Him?
questions.explanation: "...the Lord in His boar form, the enjoyer of all sacrificial offerings, playfully knocked down the mace with His left foot..." (SB 3.19.9)

questions.question: How did the Lord catch the mace the demon flung at Him?

options.text: With the same ease as Garuda would seize a serpent

questions.explanation: "...He stood firmly where He was and caught it with the same ease as Garuda, the king of birds, would seize a serpent." (SB 3.19.11)

questions.question: What weapon, 'as rapacious as a flaming fire,' did the demon next hurl at the Lord?
questions.explanation: "He now took a trident which was as rapacious as a flaming fire and hurled it against the Lord..." (SB 3.19.13)

questions.question: How did the Lord destroy the demon's flying trident?

options.text: He caught it with His foot
He tore it to pieces with His discus Sudarsana

questions.explanation: "The Personality of Godhead, however, tore it to pieces with His discus Sudarsana, which had a sharp-edged rim, even as Indra cut off a wing of Garuda." (SB 3.19.14)

questions.question: Where did the enraged demon strike the Lord with his fist, on a chest bearing what mark?
questions.explanation: "...struck his hard fist against the Lord's broad chest, which bore the mark of Srivatsa. Then he went out of sight." (SB 3.19.15)

questions.question: To what did the Lord's lack of any reaction to the demon's blow compare?

options.text: An elephant struck with a wreath of flowers

questions.explanation: "...the Lord... did not feel the least quaking in any part of His body, any more than an elephant would when struck with a wreath of flowers." (SB 3.19.16)

questions.question: During the demon's conjuring tricks, what did the sky rain down?

options.text: Pus, hair, blood, stool, urine and bones

questions.explanation: "The sky rained pus, hair, blood, stool, urine and bones." (SB 3.19.19)

questions.question: Whose heart shuddered as she recalled her husband Kasyapa's words during the battle?
questions.explanation: "At that very moment, a shudder suddenly ran through the heart of Diti, the mother of Hiranyaksa." (SB 3.19.23)

questions.question: Which weapon did the Lord discharge to disperse the demon's magical forces?
questions.explanation: "The Lord, the personal enjoyer of all sacrifices, now discharged His beloved Sudarsana, which was capable of dispersing the magical forces displayed by the demon." (SB 3.19.22)

questions.question: How did the Lord finally kill Hiranyaksa?

options.text: He cut his neck with the Sudarsana
He slapped him in the root of the ear, as Indra hit Vritra
He pierced him with an arrow
He crushed him with His mace

questions.explanation: "...Lord Adhoksaja slapped him in the root of the ear, even as Indra, the lord of the Maruts, hit the demon Vritra." (SB 3.19.25)

questions.question: To what did the demon's falling dead body compare?

options.text: A gigantic tree uprooted by the wind

questions.explanation: "...he fell down dead, like a gigantic tree uprooted by the wind." (SB 3.19.26)

questions.question: What did Brahma admiringly say upon seeing the dead demon's still-glowing face?

options.text: Oh, who could meet such blessed death?

questions.explanation: "...and Brahma admiringly said: Oh, who could meet such blessed death?" (SB 3.19.27)

questions.question: To whom did Maitreya narrate the Lord's first boar incarnation and the killing of Hiranyaksa?
questions.explanation: "Maitreya continued: My dear Vidura, I have explained to you the Personality of Godhead's coming down as the first boar incarnation and killing in a great fight a demon of unprecedented prowess..." (SB 3.19.32)

questions.question: By what name (meaning son of Kausara) is the sage Maitreya referred to in this chapter?
questions.explanation: "...by hearing the narration of the pastimes of the Supreme Personality of Godhead from the authoritative source of the sage Kausarava [Maitreya]..." (SB 3.19.33)

questions.question: What benediction is promised to one who hears the killing of Hiranyaksa?

options.text: Relief from sinful reactions, even the killing of a brahmana

questions.explanation: "...is at once relieved of the results of sinful activities, even the killing of a brahmana." (SB 3.19.37)

questions.question: Where is one transferred who listens to this narrative at the last moment of his life?

options.text: The supreme abode of the Lord

questions.explanation: "One who listens to it at the last moment of his life is transferred to the supreme abode of the Lord, O dear Saunaka." (SB 3.19.38)

questions.question: Hiranyaksha attacked the Lord by ________.

options.text: Throwing a mace against the Lord
Hurling his trident towards the Lord
Striking his fist on the Lord's chest

questions.question: The demon Hiranyaksa was finally dead when Lord ________.

options.text: Slapped him in the root of the ear
Cut his neck by His Sudarshan Chakra
Hit him on his head by His mace
Shot him with His powerful arrow

questions.question: The Lord's incarnation as boar was spoken to Vidura by ________.
Kausarava is another name of sage ________.
The benedictions offered on faithful hearing of the Lord's incarnation as boar and the killing of Hiranyaksa is ________.

options.text: It promotes strength to one's vital organs
It confers extraordinary merit, wealth, fame etc.
He is relieved of killing of even a Brahmana
